title: Answer-Level Trust Selection for Physical Vision-Language Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.19807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can estimate physical quantities such as duration, speed, and acceleration from visual observations, but existing benchmarks primarily assess overall model performance against annotated ground truth. In deployment, a key question is whether an individual prediction can be trusted when its ground truth is unavailable. Self-consistency alone may fail to capture important failure modes: a VLM may produce stable-but-wrong estimates or rely on textual priors rather than visual evidence. We formulate answer-level selective prediction for quantitative physical reasoning and propose Answer-Level Trust Selection (ATS), a post-hoc, model-agnostic framework for accepting or rejecting individual VLM predictions. ATS requires no fine-tuning, auxiliary verifier, or access to the model's internal logits. translated_title: 面向物理视觉语言推理的答案级信任选择
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19807v1 公告类型：新 摘要：视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够从视觉观察中估计持续时间、速度和加速度等物理量，但现有基准主要评估模型整体性能与标注真值的对比。在部署中，一个关键问题是当个体预测的真值不可用时，该预测是否可信。仅靠自一致性可能无法捕捉重要的失败模式：VLM可能产生稳定但错误的估计，或依赖文本先验而非视觉证据。我们针对定量物理推理提出了答案级选择性预测，并提出了答案级信任选择（ATS），这是一种事后、模型无关的框架，用于接受或拒绝单个VLM预测。ATS无需微调、辅助验证器或访问模型内部逻辑分数。相反，它聚合了来自重复查询和受控干预派生的八个可解释行为诊断分数。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需微调或内部访问的模型无关框架，通过聚合八个行为诊断分数，在物理视觉语言推理中实现单个预测的可靠接受或拒绝。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model-agnostic, post-hoc framework that aggregates eight behavioral diagnostic scores to reliably accept or reject individual predictions in physical vision-language reasoning without fine-tuning or internal logit access.
